request.state:
Use the supplied facts as design-adviser evidence, not as a runnable application benchmark. Can is currently specified in Markdown/Can files with handwritten JavaScript target sketches. Implementation has not begun; that stage is neutral in this comparison. We need advice on a finite next correction study. The same hypothetical workspace business is used for all alternatives: two sites,12 staff,120 organizations,600 member accounts,30 rooms plus 100 desks; monthly 3,000 bookings,500 invoices and 300 physical items of mail. Business staff operate web/chatbot interfaces, with an identified technical steward. Required workflows include scoped customer records, mail custody and delegation, booking/payment exceptions, truthful historical reports and coordinated recovery. Composition may be co-deployed; compare only features the company actually needs.

Dependency evidence: a local use of a production symbol includes the provider package executable as a unit under DESIGN81/89. This deliberately retains model policies/invariants/hooks/background work. A deployment-bound use imports the exported contract schemas, requires its binding, and never imports provider execution or grants privilege. There is no optional-binding or declaration-pruning rule. In CanMail, membership declarations/functions and invoice.Charge are local dependencies; invoice.BillingV1 and std.EmailV1 are unconditional bound dependencies. Nonetheless the mail-service data offers nullable term with manually recorded paid evidence, and billing can remain false. The concrete operations are receive(...) by=mail_staff guarded by current can_work and service validity; collect(item,collector,evidence) by=mail_staff guarded by current work scope, unresolved physical state and permitted_collector; forward(item,fee?,destination_verified) by=mail_staff requires a current service, no existing dispatch and verified destination/compatible fee. It enqueues a fee only if the frozen charge is nonnull. Unused billing does not currently remove installation requirements. Rent has another example: using proposal contracts and a pure helper imports proposal workflows and adapters too. Coarse packages reduce ambiguity about owning behavior. Changing them can save context/setup but may split tightly related writes or require extra imports; those consequences must be demonstrated rather than assumed. Count shared service allocations once. Specialist provider research supplies $5/month shared Workers base and$9.45/month illustrative W email overage; stewardship/setup/platform/backup estimates dominate and vary widely. No measured monetary savings from import changes exist.

Evidence preservation: each locked ResourcePolicy in CanRent contains the complete present resource settings, opening/downtime collections and booking/venue collections. One quote_accept transaction creates two snapshots. Its now value is fixed, and report lookup picks the greatest eligible sequence at a time boundary. ResourcePolicy has no declared expiry. The owning report operation is read=true scope=authority -> ReportBatch, by=reservation_manager, with can_work(actor,resource.location); outputs preserve checkpoints and completeness for historical saleable/booked/occupied measures. Those copies protect real past evidence. The desired target materializes the arrays and contains 55 snapshot call sites; no execution profile is available. A resource receiving B retained nonarchived bookings sequentially stores at least 1+2+...+B booking-value copies if it snapshots once per creation:5,050 at 100,500,500 at 1,000, before additional changes. This arithmetic is not a latency, byte-size or real optimized compiler result. Any competing representation must retain truthful as-of results through checkout delays, cancellations, capacity edits, local-time boundaries and missing history, with the same authorized disclosures. Reconstruction, replay and disposal obligations of narrower histories remain to be specified; no contender has proved equivalence.

composition.instructions: For the focused paid-evidence/no-fee mail workflow and the complete workspace version, which design direction warrants the next bounded comparison? Judge every contender on unchanged task completion, stable source authority/permissions, compact reliable AI edits and total setup/version/maintenance burden. Separate central platform cost from adopter effort. Indicate insufficient evidence when a preference would be speculative.

criteria.retain: Leave imports package-wide and make unavoidable provider requirements unmistakable in installation output. This preserves a simple established contract with little authored change; manual-evidence adopters must still configure unused capabilities.
criteria.default: Adopt used-declaration closure by default, including all necessary owner invariants, policies, hooks and asynchronous dependencies. Less unrelated setup could follow automatically; specifying and reviewing the effect reachability rule costs more and incomplete inclusion can change business behavior.
criteria.partition: Use current packages/exports/imports to give common value schemas/helpers and optional workflows explicit coherent owners while preserving each existing canonical model/operation authority. It avoids new language features; extra boundaries, imports, possible wrappers and migration work may outweigh the reduction and require evidence.
criteria.optional: Extend bound connections with a limited explicit optional mode whose absent case is typed and reflected consistently in available forms/tools. One authored variant might cover both installations; omission/version rules and testing grow, and this feature alone cannot prune local executable owners.
criteria.scope: Offer only the integrated Mail configuration supported by present imports, requiring all provider bindings. This avoids new semantics and variants but gives up the focused configuration while the company still needs its outcomes, reducing reachable adoption.
criteria.undecided: Defer selection until matched source/closure trials reveal preservation and effort. This has investigation cost and prolongs existing friction, but avoids pretending alternatives have been validated.

history.instructions: Under the same retrospective report and booking acceptance cases, what should be studied first to address growing history work? Balance exact evidence and confidentiality against storage/owner-work scaling, source simplicity, late correction/replay/retention complexity and verification effort. Treat runtime speed as unknown for all designs.

criteria.retain: Continue full snapshots and state a supported retention/workload limit. This uses the current easy-to-inspect representation; repeated historical copies remain quadratic with growing retained bookings and restricted history can narrow the promised workflow.
criteria.default: Normalize existing app writes to one final ResourcePolicy per resource per owner transaction. Potentially invisible intermediate copies could disappear with modest code change; same-time reporting must stay equivalent, and inter-transaction duplication still accumulates.
criteria.facts: Express immutable per-policy and per-booking/occupancy evidence with current typed models, adding bounded checkpoints when useful. Reduced copying could materially improve growth; replayable reconstruction, corrections and retention become harder and require new exact examples.
criteria.primitive: Add a narrowly defined derived history/checkpoint primitive around owner declarations. Common work might become shorter to author, but platform complexity and new guarantees for dependency, time/order, permissions and disposal increase; reconstruction is still required.
criteria.scope: Keep operational booking in Can while an external reporting/archive service fulfills the unchanged historical requirement. Less internal history logic comes with retained fees, integration and support, and less company-owned replacement value.
criteria.undecided: First collect a fixed 100/1,000/10,000-booking evidence-size and reconstruction comparison without choosing a representation. This delays the remedy and costs a study but preserves uncertainty about candidate correctness.
